headline: poge0593 surges from 1,531st to 89th on ARC-2

sections.text: poge0593 gained 7.22 points to reach 36.94, climbing from 1,531st to 89th on the public ARC-AGI-2 board.
The rise carries the team into the top 100 in a single reported move.
